description: DWR switched Lake Oroville to a new elevation-storage table (capacity 3,537,577 -> 3,424,753 AF; loss mainly below 420 ft). CDEC daily sensor 15 is on the old basis through 2024-07-01 and the new basis from 2024-07-02.
evidence: CDEC daily ORO 2024-07-01=3,352,893 AF vs 2024-07-02=3,229,790 AF (-123,103 AF) on a dry day while elevation (sensor 6) fell only 0.90 ft; June 2024 daily values reached ~3.53M AF (103% of new capacity); hourly sensor 15 on 2024-07-01 already ~3.24-3.25M AF.
